slides.title: Manage Users
slides.html:
Presently, you can manage user's access level and remove them from your Deploy App and all the services.

  • User Management can be accessed from the sidebar.
  • Select "Manage Users".

slides.title: Managing Users
slides.html:
• Clicking on a user opens up the actions avaivable.
  • Actions depends on the current role of the user (admin / fighter).

slides.title: Actions
slides.html:
• Fighters can be removed or promoted to "admin."
  • Admins can be removed or demoted to "fighter." User group management is an upcoming feature. Presently if you know what you are doing, you can alter them using the Keycloak interface covered next.
